title: Private VPC GA preflight and customer readiness sprint — RBAC / Audit / KMS
creator: Priya Nair
description: Organize and execute a targeted pre-GA sprint to validate operational readiness for Private/VPC on-prem feature set (RBAC, audit logging, KMS integration). Aim is to clear launch blockers, finalize release notes and hand off coordinated enablement to Sales/Support/Customer Success.
objectives: Complete final RBAC policy matrix and authorizer tests against enterprise templates
Validate end-to-end KMS key rotation and onboarding flow in a VPC staging environment
Exercise audit log ingestion and retention across supported backends and confirm compliance mappings
Publish coordinated release notes and one-page customer readiness checklist
Run two customer-facing enablement sessions and capture feedback for doc/UX fixes
success_criteria: RBAC acceptance tests pass for baseline enterprise role sets (Admin, Platform, Operator, Auditor)
KMS onboarding documented and verified by security reviewer (no blocking findings)
Audit logs show complete event coverage for deploys, access changes, and KMS operations in staging
Release notes approved by Legal and Compliance and synced to Help Center and Marketing
At least two pilot customers complete guided onboarding with >80% checklist completion
